visual_checks.name: tile_grid_seams
visual_checks.evidence: No horizontal/vertical lines at 32px or 16px spacing visible in diff10 or renders. Diff10 shows broad object-level error, not grid-aligned seams.

visual_checks.name: tile_uniform_fill
visual_checks.evidence: No constant-color square blocks replacing detail regions observed in any render.

visual_checks.name: missing_splat_holes
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images show the full object silhouette lit up with high-magnitude error (bright white/multicolor across entire object body), indicating systematic loss of splat contribution covering the entire figure. Side and top renders appear significantly darker and lower-contrast vs reference, consistent with broad missing-coverage rather than isolated holes.

visual_checks.name: color_clipping_bands
visual_checks.evidence: No saturated flat R/G/B stripes or clipping bands visible in renders.

visual_checks.name: ringing_halos
visual_checks.evidence: No structured ringing at object silhouettes observed.

visual_checks.name: nan_inf_signatures
visual_checks.evidence: No pure black/white/magenta correlated patches. No fireflies (isolated 1-3 px hot dots) visible in any render.

visual_checks.name: geometry_shift
visual_checks.evidence: Diff10 does not show a clean silhouette displacement pattern; error is distributed across the interior of the object, not a shifted outline.

visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images are dominated by structured high-magnitude error covering the entire object extent rather than uniform i.i.d. speckle. Hero diff10 shows bright white halo around full body with dense color noise interior; side and top similarly show full-body structured error. This indicates systematic culling of too many Gaussians across all views.

reasoning: REJECT on two independent hard gates. (1) PSNR catastrophic: all three views are 27.1-28.2 dB, approximately 11-13 dB below the 38 dB class-dispatch floor and 11-13 dB below the architectural baseline of ~39-41 dB. This is not a borderline regression but a catastrophic quality collapse indicating the color-magnitude culling threshold is discarding the majority of contributing Gaussians. (2) Tile_structure_ratio hard REJECT: max ratio 25.47 vs prev_best max 18.14 (iter-083), delta +7.33, far exceeding the +0.3 ratchet limit. The architectural-baseline carve-out does not apply here because this iter introduces new structural drift well above the ~17-18 baseline floor. (3) Visual confirmation: all three diff10 images show the full object body lit up with high-magnitude structured error (bright white/multicolor covering the entire figure silhouette and interior), consistent with systematic removal of a large fraction of splat pairs. The renders are visibly darker and lower-contrast than reference across all views. The kernel timing win (-38.6%) is real but purchased entirely through quality destruction — the culling criterion is far too aggressive.
